data.name: Hallamah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-l-m, meaning 'to be generous, to be gracious, to be beautiful.' This name signifies a gentle, kind, and beautiful soul. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) had a companion named Hallamah, known for her graciousness and generosity.
